name: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad
officialName: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad
summary: IIIT Hyderabad was set up in 1998 as a not-for-profit public-private partnership focused on computer science, electronics and interdisciplinary technology research, and became the model other IIITs across India were built on. Admission is purely merit-based with no category-based reservation, run through the institute's own undergraduate and postgraduate entrance examinations alongside JEE Main and board-score routes.

programs.name: BTech + MS by Research (Dual Degree) in Computer Science
programs.summary: Five-year dual degree combining a BTech with an MS by research in Computer Science. Admission is purely merit-based with no category reservation.

requirements.notes: Admission is decided by UGEE (IIIT Hyderabad Undergraduate Entrance Examination); Class XII from a recognised Indian board is the eligibility baseline. Subject and percentage conditions are set in the UGEE (IIIT Hyderabad Undergraduate Entrance Examination) eligibility rules — check the source.
